experiment_role: supplementary implementation and structural sensitivity ablation
candidate_scope: disease-filtered candidates from the current dynamic production data path

profiles.name: P45_stress
profiles.role: stress sensitivity only; not a production proposal

query_selection_policy.sampling_type: purposive convenience scenarios; not random, deterministic, or representative sampling
query_selection_policy.basis: Human-selected disease-context scenarios with existing target and exclusion caches, at least ten target candidates, complete observed exclusion-RNA coverage, and non-constant exclusion expression. The exact pair choice contains scenario judgement and was frozen before the full P00/P15/P30/P45 comparison. No Gold labels or profile-comparison outcomes were used to select the set.
query_selection_policy.interpretation: The pairs are mechanics-only implementation tests. Their exclusion genes are not asserted to be biologically undesirable, and results must not be generalised to all genes or disease contexts.

fixed_scoring_semantics.exclusion_expression: available-case mean of DepMap, HPA, and GEO RNA standardised values for the exclusion gene
fixed_scoring_semantics.exclusion_scaling: Min-Max within the disease-filtered target candidate set
fixed_scoring_semantics.missing_exclusion: penalty equals zero but remains explicitly flagged as missing evidence
fixed_scoring_semantics.top_k_policy: Top-10 plus every exact four-decimal final-score tie at the cutoff

required_checks: candidate IDs and all non-penalty score components remain fixed across profiles
penalty is between zero and the profile cap
penalty is non-decreasing as the cap increases
final score is non-increasing as the cap increases
missing exclusion evidence receives zero penalty and is not relabelled as low expression
P30 exactly reproduces an unmodified production scorer call
production script and frozen V5 design hashes do not change
zero-score clipping and exact-score tie groups are reported
synthetic_boundary_tests: lower clipping where reported penalty exceeds realised score loss
constant positive, zero, and negative exclusion values
same-base ordering under different exclusion values
claim_boundary: The experiment can establish implementation correctness, direction, clipping, ties, and ranking sensitivity in five purposively selected convenience scenarios; missing-data code-path behaviour is tested synthetically. It cannot establish that 0.30 is biologically optimal, cannot be generalised as a representative gene sample, and does not compute NDCG, Recall, MRR, or other accuracy metrics.
